posts.name: x1
posts.tagline: Lovable for iPhone apps. From idea to App Store
posts.description: X1 is an AI app builder that takes you from an idea to an iPhone app you can publish on the App Store. Instead of trying to generate the entire app from one prompt, X1 guides you step by step. It asks focused questions, designs each screen for you to review and edit, then builds the app in stages. Preview and test it on your iPhone as you go. When it’s ready, X1 prepares your App Store listing, screenshots, and submission. No coding required.

posts.name: Expertise AI
posts.tagline: Turn your GTM skills into recurring revenue
posts.description: Expertise AI is where GTM experts monetize their playbooks as protected Al skills. Each expert gets a storefront where businesses demo and install these skills on a subscription, and gets paid every time one runs.

posts.name: ChatCut Desktop
posts.tagline: Video editor built for humans & AI. Edit with GPT & Claude.
posts.description: Introducing ChatCut Desktop, the AI video editor built for humans and agents to edit together. Use ChatCut’s built-in agent, or connect ChatGPT/Codex or Claude Code. Say how you want your video edited and watch them happen on a fully editable timeline. Edit footage, create motion graphics and captions, generate video, images, music and SFX, and save reusable editing skills. Everything runs locally, and you stay in control. Export XML to Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve or CapCut.

posts.name: PostHog Desktop
posts.tagline: The product editor for product builders
posts.description: A multiplayer workspace for you, your team, and your agents – with your product data as context, and PostHog tools to ship and measure. Build and edit your product | Run a fleet of agents | Turn product signals into PRs.

posts.name: MCP-Builder.ai
posts.tagline: The fastest way to connect your data with your AI Tools.
posts.description: Build a hosted and secured MCP Server in minutes. Think of MCP-Builder.ai as Lovable for MCP connectors. Describe what you want to connect and it builds, hosts and secures your MCP Server for you. No deployment, infrastructure or security setup needed. Connect: • Databases • APIs • 3rd party apps • Files • And more Get your MCP URL, add it to Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor or any MCP compatible client and start using it.

posts.name: OpenComputer
posts.tagline: Firebase for Agents
posts.description: Introducing OpenComputer Deploy your agent as a function. Get a computer for it. - a real Linux machine per session - ffmpeg, chromium, git, install anything - durable: hibernate + resume - your keys never enter the runtime The cloud of the last decade was built for apps. The next one is for trillions of always on agents. OpenComputer is their home.

posts.name: Tellie Prompter 1.5
posts.tagline: The teleprompter that knows what you haven't said
posts.description: Most teleprompters make you follow them. Tellie follows you. It listens to the words you actually say, so you can pause, skip, improvise, or go off script without losing your place. Now Tellie 1.5 knows what you haven’t said yet, too. It tracks your important points, warns when you’re running long, and debriefs your take. All in a 3 MB Mac app that runs locally, with no account and no telemetry. Free for 10 days and $10 off for ProductHunt with code PRODHUNT10

posts.name: ify
posts.tagline: Resolution AI that works on top of your existing helpdesk
posts.description: Most AI support tools ask you to rip out your helpdesk first. Ify works on top of Freshdesk, Zendesk, Salesforce, or HubSpot and gets to work across email, chat, WhatsApp, Slack, and more. The part that usually stalls an AI support rollout is "our docs aren't good enough." Ify solves that by building its own knowledge base: it scrapes your site and docs, generates SOPs from release notes and past ticket resolutions. Built for support teams who want something live now.

posts.name: Termy
posts.tagline: Learn languages from games, videos, and websites
posts.description: Termy turns the games, videos, and websites you love into language practice. Press one shortcut and it finds the difficult words on your screen, explains them in context, and saves them with the exact moment you discovered them—without breaking your flow. Later, those moments become adaptive exercises built around your vocabulary. Works on Windows and macOS in 30 languages. Free to start.

posts.name: Mac mini
posts.tagline: Now with M6 and M5 Pro chips
posts.description: Mac mini now comes with M6 and M5 Pro, bringing faster performance, Apple Intelligence, Wi-Fi 7, and faster storage to Apple's compact 5-inch desktop. Built for coding, creating, and getting work done.

posts.name: Evidence Core
posts.tagline: Build live analytics with coding agents
posts.description: Evidence Core is an open source framework for building business intelligence applications with coding agents. Build your entire business intelligence platform as a repo of files, and deploy it anywhere, for free. Metrics, dashboards, reports and themes are all specified in code which you can validate, preview and serve using the Evidence CLI.

posts.name: LoupeKit
posts.tagline: See what any page is built with and how much of it is AI
posts.description: A developer's inspector for the page you already have open. It names the technologies behind it and shows the evidence for each, extracts the palette, fonts and assets, and scores how much of the page reads as raw AI output. It reads one tab, when you ask.

posts.name: Screenify Studio
posts.tagline: Polished product demos on Mac recorded by an AI agent
posts.description: Screenify Studio is a Mac screen recorder that turns rough recordings into polished product demos — without the editing tax. Describe a demo in plain English and an AI drives a real browser to record it, then adds cinematic 3D camera moves, spotlights, and callouts. Prefer full control? A deep editor with manual zoom keyframes. Stage recordings in a photoreal 3D MacBook, iPhone, or iPad, add on-device AI captions, or drive it all from a CLI an agent like Claude Code can run. Free to start.

posts.name: Warren
posts.tagline: Infrastructure for coding-agent workloads
posts.description: Warren runs agent harnesses as isolated, observable workloads on infrastructure you control. It owns the workspace, limits, live events, recovery, and Git delivery.

posts.name: Playcall
posts.tagline: The open-source AI alternative to Gong
posts.description: Playcall is the open-source alternative to Gong, built for AI-native GTM teams. Score every call against your playbook and the buyer context your rep was talking to. Works with MEDDPICC, BANT, SPIN, or upload your playbook and let AI generate the rubric. Get evidence-backed scores, missed moments, and outcome tracking. Every score comes with a coaching drill for the rep to run next. Self-hostable. No lock-in, no $30K/year contracts, or 10+ baked-in features your team never touches.

posts.name: Arena AI Agent
posts.tagline: Get real work done, moving from idea to shipping in minutes
posts.description: For a coding agent to be truly useful, it needs to live where the work is: on GitHub. By integrating directly with GitHub and reusing the underlying infrastructure of Agent Mode, we’ve created a seamless experience that allows you to connect a repo, complete a coding task, and push the results—all without leaving your browser.

posts.name: EasySwitch
posts.tagline: One mouse, keyboard and second screen for all your computers
posts.description: Existing tools make you choose. Software KVMs (Synergy, Deskflow, Mouse Without Borders) share your mouse and keyboard but carry no video. Second-screen apps (Duet, spacedesk, Luna) turn a spare machine into a monitor but share no input. EasySwitch does both: slide your cursor across computers, type and paste anywhere, drag files, and extend your desktop onto the machine next to you. Encryption is free for everyone, not an upsell. Wayland works. Native Rust, no Electron - 19 MB of RAM idle.

posts.name: BaudBuddy
posts.tagline: A native macOS serial terminal with a file server built in
posts.description: A native macOS terminal for serial, Bluetooth LE, Telnet and RFC 2217 consoles — with a TFTP/HTTP/HTTPS/FTP/SFTP server built in for firmware. Adapters by name, real break signals, byte-exact logs. No account, no analytics, no cloud.

posts.name: Lore Machine
posts.tagline: Substack For World Builders
posts.description: There's a new creator in town: The World Builder. Armed with the most advanced visualization technology known to man, World Builders conjure multimedia universes one serialized story at a time. But Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube weren't built to hold them. On Lore Machine, World Builders turn text into scrollable multimedia adventures called LORE, then serialize LOREs into a World with solid state characters, canon and narrative physics. Today, they can sell tickets to their World.

posts.name: DeployHermes
posts.tagline: Hire persistent Hermes agents with roles, memory + skills
posts.description: Hire persistent Hermes AI bots with a role, model, memory and skills. One click to a private runtime — missions, integrations, and receipts on every run. Integrate this with your Claude Code, Codex, and let the agents manage your bots and then your work seamlessly.

posts.name: Knack MCP Server
posts.tagline: The HIPAA-compliant backend for AI builders
posts.description: AI tools like Lovable, Base44, or Claude Code can get a healthcare app up and running quickly. The backend is where healthcare gets complicated. Once PHI is involved, you need compliant data storage, record retention, and a signed BAA. Knack Health is the HIPAA-compliant backend built for healthcare apps. Connect your AI frontend and get 700+ integrations, a signed BAA, and unlimited users starting at $499. We handle the compliance layer, so you can go from prototype to production.

posts.name: Basedash for Grok Bot
posts.tagline: Company data answers, right inside Grok Bot
posts.description: Basedash for Grok Bot sends questions to governed company data and brings the answer back into your agent. Open Plugins, add Basedash, sign in with OAuth, then ask “Which accounts drove this quarter’s NRR change?” or list the sources you can use. One hosted MCP, no API keys. Your existing Basedash workspace access controls still apply. Also available in Cursor.

posts.name: TaskShell 2.0
posts.tagline: Agent-first task management for more agentic productivity
posts.description: Manage your tasks together with your agents for complete agentic productivity. Ask to add a relevant todo as a task from your conversation mid-session, ask what's due for this week, what's most important, ask for help to plan your work, update tasks, bring up notes that are important to inject as context, and keep your agents in the loop across platforms. All through a simple but powerful MCP that syncs with all modern agents from Claude Code, to Cursor, to OpenCode, to OpenClaw, and more.

posts.name: HEVN U.S.
posts.tagline: Hold USD and pay globally through U.S. sponsor banks
posts.description: HEVN U.S. Accounts give eligible companies in 100+ countries access to USD banking through U.S. sponsor banks. Receive USD via Fedwire, hold USD, pay U.S. counterparties locally, and settle supported SWIFT payments from one platform. Built for importers, exporters, commodity traders, manufacturers, and other global businesses whose shipments and operations cannot wait for slow payment chains.

posts.name: choclift for iPad
posts.tagline: A touch-bar to control your Mac from your iPad
posts.description: choclift now turns your iPad into a beautifully simple touch companion for your Mac...and it feels like pure magic. Launch apps, run Apple Shortcuts, open websites, and add your favorite emojis to any text with a single tap, all from one resizable view. Connect multiple devices at once, tap an empty tile to add whatever is open on your Mac, and use swipe gestures for quick actions. Now available for free on Mac, iPhone, iPad, and Apple Vision Pro in eight languages.

posts.name: ReWeaver AI DriftDetector
posts.tagline: Drift score for any GitHub repo
posts.description: The code works. That was never the question. Paste any public GitHub repo and get its Production Drift Ratio (PDR) in seconds: one number for how far it sits from production-ready, plus a drift history where every point is a real scan, not an estimate. No signup, nothing to install. Deterministic rules, no LLM in the loop, no tokens burned. Nine dimensions, every finding traced to a file and a line. Try it on something vibe-coded and watch the score climb. From the team at ReWeaver AI.

posts.name: Message Album
posts.tagline: Save one iMessage conversation as a private offline album
posts.description: A native Mac app that exports one Messages conversation at a time into a searchable, iMessage-style offline website with the photos, videos and voice notes stored on your Mac. Reads your library without changing it. No account, no cloud, nothing leaves your Mac.

posts.name: macadress
posts.tagline: MAC address intelligence for apps, networks and AI agents
posts.description: Look beyond the vendor name. Understand MAC addresses with IEEE block data, device-category clues, privacy-randomization signals and plain-English reasoning. Use it through the free lookup, JSON API, bulk databases, log extractor, MCP or self-hosted deployment.

posts.name: Creatium Coach
posts.tagline: Create your own hero's journey. Go from mid to great.
posts.description: Creatium Coach is a lifelike, multimedia coach that helps anyone set goals and reach them. Instead of clicking through static courses or half-remembering a video, you learn with a coach, as well as simulations, videos, and roleplays. These boost outcomes as much as one-on-one in-person coaching. Whatever the goal, professional or personal, and whether you're one learner or a whole enterprise, Coach meets you where you are. Warning: side effects may include world domination.

posts.name: Othor AI 2.0
posts.tagline: Your AI Head of Intelligence
posts.description: BI assumes you have an analyst, a warehouse, and time. Leaders have none. Othor inverts it: connect a source, and agents start analyzing on their own. 10 new features, including Data Integration Agents (100+ sources, no migration), Analytical Agents, Decision Briefs, daily Big Picture reports, Document Intelligence, Chat with Data, Dashboards, and a Model Selector for your own LLMs. They compose - sources feed agents, agents feed briefs, briefs feed Big Picture. One pipeline, three altitudes.

posts.name: Rimplo
posts.tagline: Revenue Agents that monitor churn, upsell, and deal risk.
posts.description: Built for GTM teams, Rimplo's Revenue Agents run across your CRM, billing, support, and product data, then tell your team which accounts are at risk, where expansion is hiding, and what's slowing your open deals.

posts.name: Gemzy
posts.tagline: YOUR JEWELRY. TAKEN SERIOUSLY.
posts.description: The prompt-free AI jewelry photography studio for brands. Turn one product photo into on-model campaigns, product visuals and ready-to-publish content, in under 60 seconds. Free to start, with a 3-day free trial on Pro. Available on iOS and Android.

posts.name: Settl
posts.tagline: Speak naturally and split expenses instantly
posts.description: Just scan your bills and/or say what you spent with who in any language. Settl AI agent splits it. We have iOS, Android apps, and MCP for your other agents to directly connect to. We maintain the ledger, handle the forex, and give you insights on your spending.

posts.name: Hatano
posts.tagline: The app blocker you can't outsmart, only outwalk
posts.description: Most blockers ask for willpower: timers, delays, guilt. Hatano asks for movement. Pick the apps that steal your time; they stay locked at the system level until you hit your daily step or workout goal, verified by Apple Health. The shield re-arms every midnight. Real emergency? Beat a 30-second challenge for a 5-minute pass, twice a day max. Streaks, widgets, 14 languages, and health data that never leaves your device. You don't fight temptation. You outwalk it.

posts.name: Context Goblin
posts.tagline: Code review that knows what your PR breaks in other repos
posts.description: Context Goblin reviews pull requests. Register a second repo and it maps how your services are wired together, so the reviewer sees everything downstream that has an opinion about the change. You pick the reviewers with customizable subagents, prompts and MCPs. Install the GitHub App and your next PR gets reviewed. Free and instant for the first signed-up teams.

posts.name: Orbis: Learn Geopolitics
posts.tagline: Like Duolingo but for Geopolitics
posts.description: Orbis is a mobile app for learning geopolitics and world history in short lessons. The idea is simple. The news tell you what happened but rarely why it matters or how it got there, and most history apps hand you dates and trivia. Orbis focuses on general concepts of geopolitics: the geopgrahy, the history, the resources and how power actually works.

posts.name: Humaloo
posts.tagline: Built with AI. Grown by people.
posts.description: AI can turn an idea into a working prototype faster than ever. Humaloo helps with what comes next. It’s a place for founders and builders to showcase AI-native projects, share their progress, and make their next challenge visible. Discover promising projects, contribute your expertise, or connect with co-founders, domain experts, designers, developers, marketers, and experienced operators who can help turn an early build into a trusted, market-ready product.

posts.name: T&C Simplified
posts.tagline: Know what your insurance policy actually says.
posts.description: Built this after my sibling's health insurance claim got rejected over a clause on page 14 nobody reads. Upload your policy pdf or answer a few quick questions and it flags the clauses that usually cause claim rejections, explained in plain language instead of insurance jargon. Covers health, term and motor insurance right now, works in english, hindi, marathi and telugu. No login, doesn't store your data, and it only tells you what's in the policy, not whether to buy it or not.

posts.name: Slash Anywhere
posts.tagline: Custom slash commands that work everywhere you type.
posts.description: Create custom slash commands to instantly insert text, snippets, variables, and more on any website. Type "/" and instantly access your favorite commands, text snippets, templates, and shortcuts on any website. Stop copying and pasting the same information over and over again. With Slash Anywhere, you can create custom slash commands that let you insert text instantly wherever you type. Just type "/" in any text field, choose a command, press Enter, and you're done.

posts.name: SimplyDiskSweeper
posts.tagline: See what uses space before moving files to Trash
posts.description: Choose a folder and browse items largest first in Finder-like columns. See what the scan could not include, show repository/git-ignored items, and find exact duplicates (hardlinks). Only items you select move to Trash, after confirmation.

posts.name: Akalan AI
posts.tagline: The flight simulator for AI-led interviews
posts.description: Most interview prep tools give you question banks and tips. But knowing what to say is not the same as performing under pressure. Akalan is the flight simulator for AI-led hiring. Step into realistic AI interview simulations, get instant analysis on how you communicate, and pinpoint your blind spots. Practice repeatedly until you build real muscle memory. Don't just prepare for interview questions. Train for the interview itself.

posts.name: Eurobase
posts.tagline: The Sovereign BaaS for Europe
posts.description: Eurobase - Firebase simplicity. Postgres power. European sovereignty. An EU infra alternative to Supabase/Firebase with GDPR compliance by design, 5-minute onboarding and DSAR exports out of the box. Eurobase offers auth, database, storage, realtime, edge functions, cron, vault, webhooks, and CLI — fully EU-native, zero US jurisdiction, zero DevOps. One-click GDPR DSAR exports — built in and audit-trailed.

posts.name: CalNote
posts.tagline: The Apple Notes of food tracking.
posts.description: Hi Product Hunt! 👋 I'm Ogan, relaunching CalNote after major changes since our first launch in February. Calorie tracking is a chore, so we fixed it. CalNote is the “Apple Notes” of diet apps: type what you ate or snap a photo, and AI calculates calories & macros in seconds. No barcodes, databases, or rigid forms. New: meal-time splitting, AI meal suggestions, menu scanning, weight progress tracking, better tracking reminders, coach connections, and 8+ languages.

posts.name: freehire
posts.tagline: The open-source job search that covers every board
posts.description: Job search is broken — every platform is a walled garden with its own exclusive listings. FreeHire is a search engine for jobs: it indexes 3M+ live jobs from 98 ATS platforms and other aggregators into one fast, deduplicated search. Open source, free, no lock-in — and API-first, so an AI agent can search the whole market for you. The goal: make all the world's job data easy to find, for everyone.

posts.name: ContentPulse
posts.tagline: The content engine that keeps your articles ranking
posts.description: Turn a brief into a researched, SEO-ready article with images — then ContentPulse publishes it to 14+ CMSs and refreshes it on schedule so it keeps ranking. Live web research, your brand voice, 59 languages, full autopilot. 3 free articles.

posts.name: MapleFlow.io - One Key for Everything
posts.tagline: One key for AI, identity verify, and utility APIs
posts.description: The Everything API for builders. Power you apps with AI models, ID Verification, and many more utility features without juggling keys or minimum spends. 34 AI models across 7 providers, plus face verification and utility APIs — all on one key, one credit balance. Verify a face for ~$0.02 instead of $1-2 from Persona/Onfido. And more features as we build together.... No seats. No enterprise sales calls. Credits don't expire.

posts.name: Ai SaaS Cost vs. Profit Analyzer
posts.tagline: Analyze SaaS cost vs. Profit Margins for free
posts.description: Calculate your SaaS revenue, operating costs, profit margin, break-even point, and unit economics at 1 to 10,000 customers. Free SaaS profitability calculator for indie hackers and founders.

posts.name: Bidify
posts.tagline: Discover what's being built across the Shopify ecosystem
posts.description: The bidding leaderboard for the Shopify ecosystem. Pay for attention. Compete for position.Bidify is a discovery platform for the Shopify ecosystem. Discover Shopify apps, agencies, freelancers, stores and other projects in one place. Instead of searching across multiple platforms to find who's building what, Bidify brings the ecosystem together into a single discovery layer. Built for people who work with, build for, or simply want to explore the Shopify ecosystem.

posts.name: plym
posts.tagline: Open source CMS for ridiculous speed, auto-SEO & GEO
posts.description: plym is an open source CMS that serves content to both agents and humans, at ridiculous ⚡️ speed. Agents get raw markdown: <80% fewer tokens, cleaner context. Humans get, well, a human page. It's heavily optimised for speed, SEO and AI discoverability. You hit 100/100 on PageSpeed out of the box for blogs built using plym. It's highly customisable (everything including the entire template), but ships with pretty well-thought defaults. Neither a config maze nor an opaque wall.

posts.name: Bettie
posts.tagline: Prediction Markets for Friends & Teams
posts.description: The gamified prediction market. Place bets on questions about politics, sports, who has the next breakup in the friend group, everything...: with play money, leaderboards, and mini leagues. No real money. Create your own satirical bets for your office, startup, club, or friends' league and mix the polymarket style bets from our editorial team into it.

posts.name: Dabba Phone
posts.tagline: Physical Pause Button for all the devices in your family
posts.description: Dabba Phone creates one minute of distraction-free connection. Because real life is worth showing up for. Pre-order the one-minute button that brings people back together.

posts.name: Dataguessr
posts.tagline: A fun way to learn about the world and find your blind spots
posts.description: Update your knowledge of the world. One quiz at a time. Dataguessr is a free browser game based on real-world statistics. Your job is to compare countries and get them in the correct order: Which country has seen the largest growth in productivity? Which countries are most gender-equal? Where do most people live in cities? Annual working hours? GDP per capita? Patent applicatations? Be prepared to be surprised!

posts.name: LinkRadar Lite
posts.tagline: Find the backlink gaps your competitors already fill, free
posts.description: Type your domain. LinkRadar Lite pulls the keywords you rank for and your closest competitors, then scores real publishers from a 225,000+ catalogue against them, with live prices and how far under market each one sits. No signup, no credit card.

posts.name: Local Waifu
posts.tagline: A private AI companion that lives on your computer,
posts.description: This launch brings Local Waifu to Windows, alongside the existing Mac version. We also added image generation with both local and cloud models, plus local voice responses and full voice calls. The goal of this release was to make the companion feel much more complete across both platforms, not just text chat, but images, voice, calls and persistent memory in one app.

posts.name: Airtasker ChatGPT Plugin
posts.tagline: Get anything done, all inside ChatGPT
posts.description: Airtasker is now the first local services marketplace with a full task experience inside ChatGPT. Whether it’s to mount a TV or deep clean your home, describe what you need, and ChatGPT will help write the task, suggest a budget and connect you with a Tasker to get it done. Available now in Australia, Ireland, New Zealand, Singapore, the UK and the US.

posts.name: Deep Enrich
posts.tagline: Find your prospects’ emails and phone numbers easily
posts.description: Deep Enrich runs your list through multiple data vendors in a waterfall enrichment, then verifies every email and validates every phone. Competitive find rates and bounce rates worldwide, all in one subscription. Chrome extension, spreadsheet upload, and API included.

posts.name: MCU Prep
posts.tagline: Gamified MCU watch-order tracker with daily trivia
posts.description: Most MCU watch-order lists are static spreadsheets or blog posts. MCU Prep turns it into a tracked checklist — chronological or release order — with XP, tiered achievement badges, and a daily 10-question trivia mode with its own leaderboard. Free, bilingual EN/ES, unofficial fan project built solo ahead of Avengers: Doomsday (Dec 18, 2026)

posts.name: NeuraKeep
posts.tagline: Source-cited memory for AI agents
posts.description: Give Claude, Codex, OpenClaw, and other MCP clients one source-cited memory layer. Agents search sources and propose updates; people review what becomes durable. Run locally from GitHub or use hosted personal and team spaces with governed remote MCP access.

posts.name: Folio V1
posts.tagline: Local-first novel writing, now on every desktop
posts.description: Folio is a free, local-first desktop writing studio for novelists. Draft and organize Markdown chapters, plan beats and story threads, build a Codex, track revisions and snapshots, and export to PDF, DOCX, EPUB, Markdown, or TXT. Muse provides manuscript-aware AI through fully local Gemma or your own cloud API keys - while your book remains on your disk. Available for macOS, Windows, and Linux.

posts.name: DubBooth
posts.tagline: Say the line. Beat the original. A dub game in your browser
posts.description: DubBooth is a free dubbing game that runs entirely in your browser. Hear a line from a real scene, say it in your own voice, and get three scores — rhythm, duration, coverage. Your takes are stitched back into the scene and the finished dub exports as a video, all client-side. Play 60+ community scenes, import your own packs, or turn any video into a playable scene with the AI pack maker. No download, no account, and your mic audio stays on your device.

posts.name: Presentation Timer
posts.tagline: Presentation Timer App That Keeps You on Time
posts.description: Set a quick timer, build color-coded custom timers, or chain multi-session agendas with drag-and-drop. Cast to any TV or browser, then control everything remotely from your phone while you present.

posts.name: Premium Themes for Google Gemini
posts.tagline: Customize Google Gemini Premium Themes, a Live Style Editor
posts.description: Customize Google Gemini UI with animated premium themes, a live style editor, custom dark mode colors, and adjustable font settings. Customize the Google Gemini UI, enable a custom dark mode, dynamically change font sizes, and apply breathtaking animated backgrounds with Anwingels. As the ultimate UI customizer and productivity suite, this extension empowers professionals, developers, and creatives to eliminate eye strain and take total control over their AI workspace.

posts.name: Fomo Bot
posts.tagline: Research Fomo traders from your terminal
posts.description: Fomo CLI is a read-only research tool for exploring Fomo traders, clans, wallets, and activity from your terminal. Collect data locally, compare trader performance, study token flow, test strategies, and send activity to webhooks.

posts.name: NOMADS
posts.tagline: A leaderboard for products where your bid sets your rank
posts.description: NOMADS is a leaderboard for products. Pick one of eight world monuments and claim a spot on its board. Bid higher to climb, and your listing never expires. Every listing shows its live click count, so you can see what a spot is worth before you take it.

posts.name: BasicInventory
posts.tagline: Offline inventory for Windows. One payment, no subscription.
posts.description: Products, locations, lots and expiry dates, with a recorded movement behind every change. Runs on your PC, offline, data in one local file. An AI assistant answers questions about your stock using your own key. Try the whole app in your browser first.

posts.name: Treyspace
posts.tagline: An AI canvas that understands how your ideas connect
posts.description: Treyspace turns an infinite canvas into a queryable knowledge graph. Draw, connect and organise information naturally, then ask questions across the whole canvas. Unlike ordinary RAG, Treyspace preserves the relationships, groups and spatial structure between elements, retrieves the relevant context, and highlights the sources behind its answers.

posts.name: CryptoWorld News
posts.tagline: Whale flows, signals & on-chain data on one screen
posts.description: Everything happening in crypto on one screen. Whale movements across 18 exchanges and 72 chains with wallet labelling and association, live derivatives, exchange net-flows, stablecoin supply and ETF custody. A confluence engine scores 383 coins across 10 signals every few minutes, plus directional signals, in-house charting, news from 158 sources, a global map and per-coin alerts. For active retail traders. £14.99/mo founding price, 7-day trial, no card.

posts.name: HTML to PDF API
posts.tagline: Turn HTML & web pages into PDFs with one API call
posts.description: Generate professional PDFs from HTML or live web pages with a simple API. Customize page size, margins, viewport, CSS, headers and footers, render dynamic content, and generate PDFs from authenticated pages.

posts.name: Orbit by Postman
posts.tagline: Turn any task into the right API calls - built for AI agents
posts.description: Describe your task, and Orbit finds public API endpoints that fit, then generates instructions to call them, from auth to gotchas. Built for agents to discover, evaluate, and integrate public APIs.

posts.name: Koofie
posts.tagline: Free SEO audit of any website in 10 seconds, no signup
posts.description: Paste a URL, get a full SEO audit in 10 seconds. No account, no credit card. Koofie returns a 0-100 score with Domain Authority, backlinks, Core Web Vitals, schema, DNS health and a prioritized fix list. Create a free workspace and it keeps going: daily Google rank tracking, keyword gaps vs a competitor, a CTR forecast, and an AI-presence check that measures how often Perplexity cites your domain. Hosted in Switzerland, no third-party trackers. Free for 1 project, $9/mo for 5.

posts.name: Folio V1

posts.name: VPN Peek 3.0
posts.tagline: The VPN monitor that admits when it can't be sure
posts.description: VPN Peek 3.0 is a near-total rewrite. Most VPN leak tests slap a green checkmark on you, but if you run WARP, NextDNS or any loopback resolver, that check is meaningless. 3.0 adds a third state, "Not Fully Verified", telling you when it genuinely can't confirm you're safe instead of guessing. It asks the kernel which interface your DNS actually leaves through, keeps leak history with timestamps, and still works with the wifi off. Native SwiftUI, no tracking.
